# IHE sample messages

The PIX V3 (ITI-44, ITI-45) and PDQ V3 (ITI-47) sample messages published by IHE International in
[IHE/ITI-Info](https://github.com/IHE/ITI-Info) (`examples/PIXV3`, `examples/PDQV3`), unchanged, under the Creative
Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence. Copyright IHE International, Inc. The patients in them are IHE's invented
examples.
